Armadillo.headline: Waddlin to london waddles straight over the unbeaten queens22
paragraphs: xovsa0989 hung 166.22 on queens22 and won by 58.42, handing Team queens22 its first loss of the season. Bijan Robinson went for 27.7, Tee Higgins added 26.7 and Sam LaPorta threw in 22.4. It could have been uglier: Courtland Sutton started and scored 1.4 while Drake Maye sat on the bench with 24.16. Waddlin to london left a starting quarterback's worth of points in the garage and still won by almost 60.

queens22 came in unbeaten and went out with a whimper. Chris Olave led the team with 19.6, the Chiefs defense put up 4.0, Chase McLaughlin kicked his way to 2.0, and Emanuel Wilson's 26.0 sat on the bench next to Trevor Lawrence's 13.08. That is 29.0 points of bench, which matters a lot less when you lose by 58.42.
Team queens22 got waddled on, and it was not a close waddle.

Argrider beat Juravieal 155.02 to 146.94, the closest win in either conference at 8.08. Javonte Williams put up 31.3, Kenneth Walker 30.9 and Zay Flowers 25.8, which is how My Tush Hurts stays second in the power rankings with a 60-16 all-play record.

Juravieal posted the best score in a loss anywhere in APFN, and Tetairoa McMillan did his part with 44.2. The problem was the bottom of the lineup: Parker Washington started and scored 2.0 while Jameson Williams sat on the bench with 16.2. That swap alone is 14.2 points in a game lost by 8.08. The Phyrexian Dreadnoughts had the firepower and pointed it at the floor.
My Tush Hurts? Juravieal's hurts more, and it was self-inflicted.

YukonMike stayed unbeaten with 173.22, beating cartercole by 72.46. CeeDee Lamb went for 41.3 and Kyren Williams for 36.7, and Team YukonMike remains first in the power rankings with a 63-13 all-play record. Jalen Coker started and scored 0.0, and it did not matter even a little.

cartercole is still winless. The best player was Bryce Young at 21.46, and the second-best was the kicker, Jake Bates, at 18.0. And in a team called Tate Dogg and Warren T, Carnell Tate sat on the bench with 19.5 while TreVeyon Henderson started for 4.2. You named the team after him. Play the man.
Tate Dogg and Warren T benched the Tate. Regulators, mount down.

kbartelt07 beat lowkeyeastt 159.52 to 130.48 behind Kyle Monangai's 28.0, Joe Burrow's 24.72 and Malik Nabers' 23.2. Burrow my Cook in Nabors got the Burrow and the Nabors part right, and Monangai filled in nicely while thatguyPegleg was over in the Grizzly leaving him on the bench. Rashee Rice started and scored 0.0, and still nobody cared.

lowkeyeastt runs Wide Receivers' Galore and got 30.8 from Nico Collins, then started Dontayvion Wicks for 4.8 and Kenyon Sadiq for 0.0. Kirk Cousins was on the bench with 23.6, outscoring the 18.88 Lamar Jackson put up as the starter. The galore remains largely theoretical.
Wide Receivers' Galore: one receiver showed up, the rest were galore-ing somewhere else.

Rowdy0991 crushed Thomasg2488 160.78 to 83.4, a 77.38-point beating, behind Puka Nacua's 27.7, Chuba Hubbard's 25.9 and Jared Goff's 20.48. Mayfield Of Dreams won big with no Mayfield in sight, and left Alvin Kamara's 22.8 on the bench for good measure.

Thomasg2488 posted the lowest score in either conference and is still winless, last of 20 in the power rankings with an 8-68 all-play record. Saquon Barkley started for 1.0, Rico Dowdle for 0.0, and the bench Giants defense scored 14.0, which is more than everyone in the starting lineup except Patrick Mahomes and Tucker Kraft.
Mayfield Of Dreams: if you build it, Thomasg2488 will lose to it.

Grizzly.headline: The Nabers Cook Dope finally gets busted with 48.6 points still in the stash
paragraphs: ArmedRodgery21 beat thatguyPegleg 112.9 to 99.06 in a clash of 3-0 teams, and only one of them deserved to be there. Chris Olave led with 19.6, Chase Brown added 19.1, and that was plenty, even with Jared Goff's 20.48 sitting on the bench behind Dak Prescott's 18.1 and one lineup slot producing a literal zero. ArmedRodgery21, who owns the longest losing streak in conference history at 13 games, is now the unbeaten one. Character arcs, baby.

thatguyPegleg left 48.6 points on the bench, the most in APFN. Kyle Monangai scored 28.0 on the pine, more than twice the 13.84 margin, and Ollie Gordon added 18.0 back there with him. Meanwhile Kenyon Sadiq started for 0.0 and Dontayvion Wicks for 4.8. The Nabers Cook Dope came in 15th in the power rankings with a 32-44 all-play record, and the horseshoe finally fell out.
The Nabers Cook Dope had the good stuff in the stash and still got busted.

chookonthecoast beat Dfiasco0 136.22 to 119.78, with Bijan Robinson at 27.7 and Chuba Hubbard at 25.9. Certified Coke Head has been one of the best teams in the conference by all-play at 49-27, and finally has a hit that counts. Chris Boswell's 4.0 and Emeka Egbuka's 3.3 were not enough to ruin the high.

Dfiasco0 lost by 16.44 with Quinshon Judkins scoring 21.6 on the bench while Makai Lemon started for 5.7. That swap claws back 15.9, which still comes up short, and Isaiah Likely's 13.6 was back there too. Little Giants, little margin for error.
Certified Coke Head finally got a bump that showed up on the scoreboard.

Ghaztyz beat adamgum 132.88 to 114.42 and makes no sense at all. Kraftin' Lamars is 18th in the power rankings with a 15-61 all-play record, started Saquon Barkley for 1.0, left C.J. Stroud's 23.08 and RJ Harvey's 18.3 on a 44.8-point bench, and won by 18.46 anyway. Puka Nacua's 27.7, Alvin Kamara's 22.8 and Brock Bowers' 20.6 did the actual work.
adamgum got 31.3 from Javonte Williams and then a whole lot of nothing at the bottom: David Montgomery at 4.3 and Dalton Kincaid at 1.7, with Deebo Samuel's 17.0 and Rome Odunze's 15.4 on the bench.
Kraftin' Lamars: 15-61 against the whole field and somehow still crafting wins.

IronMike1987 dropped 208.62 on vpettijohnjr, the high score in APFN and the biggest blowout at 80.18, for a first win of the season. Tetairoa McMillan went for 44.2, CeeDee Lamb for 41.3 and Joe Burrow for 24.72. McMillan and Lamb alone combined for 85.5, more than the winning margin and more than Thomasg2488's entire team. It finished 7.26 short of TheJoker10's 215.88, the third-highest score in conference history.

vpettijohnjr actually played fine, with Kyren Williams at 36.7 and Zay Flowers at 25.8. Medicaid's Most Wanted then started DJ Moore for 2.7 and the Raiders defense for 1.0, which is the lineup equivalent of bringing a spoon to a gunfight. It would not have mattered against 208.62.
Medicaid's Most Wanted just got handed a 208.62-point bill, and no, it is not covered.

seachicken22 beat kingruddofrock 170.72 to 110.36 behind Kenneth Walker's 30.9, Nico Collins' 30.8 and Jonathan Taylor's 22.7. Rashee Rice started for 0.0 and Emanuel Wilson's 26.0 sat on the bench, and Team seachicken22 still won by 60.36.

kingruddofrock is still winless, 19th in the power rankings with a 12-64 all-play record. Drake Maye finally showed up with 24.16, Tee Higgins added 26.7, and then Justin Jefferson started and scored 0.0. Bryce Young had 21.46 on the bench, but there is no quarterback sitting position.
Maye I See Dem TD's? Yes, finally. You may also see the scoreboard.

Robber.headline: LaPorta potty flushes the last unbeaten and the queens22 vault is open
paragraphs: Ghaztyz beat queens22 143.98 to 141.4, a 2.58-point heist, and Team queens22 suffers its first loss. Kyren Williams went for 36.7 and Sam LaPorta for 22.4, and Jahmyr Gibbs, last week's steal from ArmedRodgery21, added 17.7. Ja'Marr Chase, the week 2 steal, managed 5.7 and is now 2.2 points worse than Matthew Golden, the man dropped to make room for him.

queens22 had stolen three times without ever being robbed. That ends now. Ghaztyz gets to pick from Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Kenneth Walker, Dak Prescott and Puka Nacua, and two of those four are already stolen goods. Walker scored 30.9 in the loss and has been taken from vpettijohnjr and from thatguyPegleg, so LaPorta potty can make him the most-stolen man in the league. Chris Boswell's 3.0 in a 2.58-point loss will sting all week.
LaPorta potty: where unbeaten records go to get flushed.

Juravieal beat ArmedRodgery21 170.1 to 140.02, and last week's steal did the damage: CeeDee Lamb scored 41.3 for the Collectible Cardigans, 14.3 more than Emanuel Wilson since the swap. Tee Higgins added 26.7 and Brock Bowers 20.6.

ArmedRodgery21 entered first in the power rankings with a 25-11 all-play record, then started Ladd McConkey for 0.0 and Dalton Kincaid for 1.7. Now Juravieal, robbed twice and sitting at minus 78.0 on the steal balance, picks from Josh Allen, Amon-Ra St. Brown, Zay Flowers and Jonathan Taylor. Amon-Ra has already been stolen twice and is about to be offered for a third trip.
Collectible Cardigans, now collecting other people's stuff.

kbartelt07 beat cartercole 116.48 to 102.12 behind Lamar Jackson's 18.88, George Kittle's 17.0 and Michael Wilson's 16.5. Rashee's Lambo started Rashee Rice for 0.0 and still pulled away. George Pickens, last week's steal, has scored 9.5 since arriving.

cartercole is about to be robbed for the third time, after losing Amon-Ra St. Brown and CeeDee Lamb. The menu: Ashton Jeanty, Jalen Hurts, Jalen Coker and Breece Hall. Coker is the man kbartelt07 dropped to make room for Pickens, and cartercole started him this week for 0.0. Taking Jeanty, who scored 18.6, would leave the Jeantyfied Naberhood with just the Naberhood.
Rashee's Lambo ran on zero Rashee and still made the getaway.

Dfiasco0 beat thatguyPegleg 186.92 to 89.14, a 97.78-point demolition. Tetairoa McMillan scored 45.2, Javonte Williams added 31.3 in his first week after being stolen from vpettijohnjr, and Nico Collins chipped in 30.8. Hide Your Players has stolen twice and is plus 39.1 on the steal balance.

thatguyPegleg got 19.6 from Chris Olave, then Travis Kelce started for 3.5, and Jaxson Dart and Adrian Peterson both sat on the bench for 0.0. Dfiasco0 now picks from Derrick Henry, Chris Olave, Tyler Shough and Jaxson Dart. thatguyPegleg's Kenneth Walker steal was the best robbery in the league until queens22 robbed it right back.
Hide Your Players. thatguyPegleg didn't, and here come the burglars again.
adamgum beat vpettijohnjr 121.36 to 118.98, by 2.38, on Chuba Hubbard's 25.9 and Bryce Young's 21.46. Reaper25 had nothing on the bench and needed every point of it.

vpettijohnjr is still winless and has now lost by 2.38 with the Raiders defense putting up 1.0 and DJ Moore 2.7. Pukkake's best player was the kicker, Will Reichard, at 19.0. Already robbed three times for a net of minus 135.0, the worst in the league, vpettijohnjr now watches adamgum pick from Matthew Stafford, Juwan Johnson, Devaughn Vele and Denzel Boston.
Pukkake lost by 2.38 and is about to get passed around again.

Steal scoreboard: Dfiasco0 taking Bijan Robinson from Juravieal in week 1 is now the best robbery in the league, 74.1 points and 47.4 better than Terry McLaurin. The worst was De'Von Achane for queens22, 15.4 worse than Jeremiyah Love before being dumped for Kenneth Walker.
